outcome: posttraumatic stress disorder symptoms following childbirth
cohort: 541 French-speaking women with infants aged 1 to 12 months old
finding: The French version of the City Birth Trauma Scale (City BiTS-F) is a reliable and valid measure of PTSD-FC symptoms in French-speaking women, with a two-factor model comprising birth-related symptoms and general symptoms demonstrating the best fit to the data.
